group.label: Cookie Consent
group.comment: The visitor's choice of analytics and marketing cookies, for every tracker on the storefront (Google Analytics, …). Shown only while a tracker is on. Necessary cookies (cart, checkout, sign-in) need no consent.

field.label: Ask for Consent
field.comment: Yes (EU, UK: GDPR, ePrivacy): analytics and marketing are off until the visitor chooses in the banner (Accept, Reject, Choose). No (e.g. a US-only store): on from the start; the visitor can still turn them off in Cookie Settings or with Do Not Sell or Share.

field.label: Honor Global Privacy Control
field.comment: A browser sending the GPC signal (Brave, DuckDuckGo, Firefox with the setting, privacy extensions) opts out of marketing cookies: required in California (CCPA/CPRA) and several other US states. A visitor can still opt in afterwards in Cookie Settings.

field.label: Show "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information"
field.comment: A footer link (CCPA/CPRA) that opens the cookie choices. For stores selling to California.

field.label: Privacy Policy URL
field.comment: Linked from the banner, e.g. /privacy-policy-cookie-restriction-mode. Empty: no link.

group.label: Personal Data (GDPR)
group.comment: My Account > Privacy: the customer downloads everything the store keeps about them (GDPR art. 15 and 20) and can delete their account (art. 17).

field.label: Customers Can Delete Their Account
field.comment: After confirming with their password (an account without a password, made by a social sign-in: through a link emailed to the account). No: the page offers the download only, and asks them to write to the store.

field.label: Anonymize the Orders of a Deleted Account
field.comment: Yes: names, emails, addresses and phone numbers are taken off the customer's orders, invoices, shipments and credit memos; amounts, items, country and tax stay for the accounts. No: the orders keep them, where the law asks the store to keep its invoices as issued (art. 17(3)(b)); they become guest orders.

field.label: Deletion Link Email
field.comment: Sent to an account without a password that asks to be deleted: the link (valid one hour, used once) deletes it.
